name: 시드라
light: On a rocky tidal causeway in clear cool morning light, poised front three-quarter adult woman. Deep blue enamel slim plates, cream ribbed breastplate and small cream-tipped spiny fin-shaped shoulder and forearm edges. Coiled tail becomes a layered curled blue waist sash, tiny fin crown, face unobstructed. Human skin. Full head and boots with margins, both empty open hands held separately beside hips.
casual: In an empty hilltop observatory demonstration alcove at violet dusk, standing beside a brass telescope, one open hand indicating its lens and the other relaxed away from her waist. Knees included, face toward viewer, dome slit and a few stars behind.

Original adult astronomy event-guide outfit: fully opaque navy halter-neck fitted mini dress with cream geometric side openings at waist, secure chest coverage, narrow silver belt and ankle boots. Bare shoulders arms legs and side waist, tiny fin-shaped silver earrings. No words or insignia.

On an empty salt-marsh boardwalk at bright windy noon, taking a slow step toward camera after a long walk, both empty hands swinging apart naturally. Entire figure and shoes with ample reed beds and distant dunes, hair moving in breeze.

Opaque cream sleeveless button-front cropped shirt with secure blue bandeau underlayer and deep-blue high-waisted wide-leg hiking shorts, open sandals. Bare shoulders arms midriff and legs, small curled-tail pendant.

Inside a quiet antique music-box workshop on a rainy evening, sitting side-on at a low worktable, one hand gently turning a large music-box winding key while the other rests open beside the wooden case. Face turned slightly to viewer, both complete hands visible, warm bench lamp.

Opaque blue off-shoulder ribbed fitted top with elbow-length sleeves and secure neckline, cream high-waisted skirt below crop. Bare shoulders upper chest and a narrow midriff, tiny cream bead bracelet.
